author: Numberz_
body:
Hi, 
This will probably be something the devs will won't do but its worth a shot. Is there anyway the leaderboards can be revamped back to the way they were before? The one with the graph charts and pie charts on the profiles. The month by month kills and death was a neat feature. I'm not sure if it was removed due to the experience being replaced with credits but if there is anyway this could be brought back that would be sweet. 

Also I was going through screenshots from the old website from like 2 1/2 years ago and saw the cross out on banned players. I don't know if that would be completely useful now but looked pretty cool. ;p
